rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the relationship or direction is reversed.

example.english: You help me, and conversely, I'll help you.
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 ngo5 faan2 gwo3 lei4 bong1 nei5

rows.meaning: from the other point of view
rows.note: Use this when presenting the other point of view or the other side of an argument.

example.english: Conversely, this plan has its advantages too.
example.traditional: 另一方面，呢個方案都有好處。
example.jyutping: ling6 jat1 fong1 min6 ni1 go3 fong1 ngon3 dou1 jau5 hou2 cyu3
